scenarios.scenario_abstract: After the wedding party commits to army-green suits and a formal dress code, [X] settles on black formal shoes and checks that the chosen pair remains coordinated through the ceremony, photographs, standing, and reception movement.
examples: using Formal Event as the gate because the dress code and wedding role are explicit
keeping the selected black formal pair tied to the fixed army-green suit
checking ceremony-to-reception comfort without relabeling the event as casual
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 婚礼团队确定军绿色西装和正式婚礼着装要求后，[X]会最终选择黑色正装鞋，并继续确认这双鞋在仪式、合影、久站和宴会走动中都协调且合适。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a winter stay in the countryside, [X]'s family of four assigns footwear roles for snowy outdoor play, wet walks, travel days, and warm indoor time so the children and adults do not rely on one unsuitable pair for every part of the visit.
examples: using Vacation for the family trip and Outdoor for snow, wet paths, and play
using Daily for travel and ordinary village movement
keeping a separate Home/Indoor role for the house or cabin
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备冬季乡村探亲时，[X]一家四口会为雪地活动、潮湿步行、出行日和温暖室内分别安排不同用途的鞋，避免大人和孩子用同一双不合适的鞋应付整段行程。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After buying a brown dress, [X] searches for white garden-wedding shoes, but a wide forefoot makes the decision depend on whether a formal-looking option can stay stable on grass and avoid pinching through the outdoor ceremony and reception.
examples: using Formal Event for the wedding rather than treating color coordination alone as the task
using Outdoor for grass stability and dirt exposure at the garden venue
rejecting an elegant pair when width or ground contact makes it unwearable
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 买好棕色礼服后，[X]会为花园婚礼寻找白鞋，但宽前掌使选择取决于鞋子能否既保持正式感，又能在草地上稳定，并在户外仪式和宴会期间不夹脚。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a five-day July trip from Halifax to Seoul, [X] plans around monsoon rain: waterproof footwear must handle long palace, market, and neighborhood walks, while museums or malls remain alternatives when heavy weather displaces a hike or shore day.
examples: using Vacation for the committed international trip and Daily for repeated city walking
using Outdoor for rain-exposed routes and only for optional activities that survive the forecast
treating indoor attractions as a real weather pivot rather than a claim that every activity will occur
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从哈利法克斯前往首尔度过七月的五天时，[X]会围绕季风降雨安排鞋履：防水鞋要应付宫殿、市场和街区的长距离步行，暴雨取消徒步或岸边活动时则转入博物馆和商场。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For graduation, [X] matches shoes to a pink floral dress, directly compares platform lift with support for ceremony standing and walking, and ultimately commits to a strappy platform form for the finished formal outfit.
examples: using Formal Event for the graduation ceremony and photographs
keeping the selected strappy platform tied to the already fixed dress
checking support and movement without inventing a try-on or completed ceremony
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为毕业典礼给粉色碎花裙搭鞋时，[X]会直接比较厚底增高与仪式期间站立、行走所需支撑，最终确定以绑带厚底鞋完成这套正式造型。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a high-energy sea vacation in Cancun, [X]'s family assigns a compact footwear rotation across beach and water time, daytime resort or excursion movement, relaxed family meals, and a dressier farewell dinner or evening out.
examples: using Beach and Vacation for the committed sea trip
using Outdoor and Daily for excursions, resort movement, and ordinary walking
using Party or Formal Event only for the explicitly planned evening and farewell-dinner roles
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备前往坎昆进行高强度海滨度假时，[X]一家会用精简的鞋履轮换覆盖沙滩和水上时间、白天的度假村或外出活动、轻松家庭用餐，以及更讲究的告别晚餐或夜间活动。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: By separating long city walks and transit, beaches, religious or cultural sites, and possible monsoon conditions, [X] chooses footwear roles that respect indoor-entry expectations without sacrificing outdoor grip or all-day comfort.
examples: using Vacation and Daily for the trip and repeated urban movement
using Beach only for the explicit shore visits and Outdoor for weather-exposed walking
accounting for easy removal at relevant sites without converting them into Home/Indoor use
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 把城市长距离步行与交通、海滩、宗教或文化场所及可能的季风天气区分开后，[X]会选择既尊重需要脱鞋进入的场所规则，又兼顾户外抓地和全天舒适的相应鞋履。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a countryside visit to their grandmother, [X] packs for uneven outdoor paths and ordinary walking while keeping an easy, clean indoor option for time in the house, with luggage limited by bus or train transfers.
examples: using Outdoor for uneven paths and sturdy walking needs
using Daily for station transfers and ordinary movement during the visit
using Home/Indoor for extended time in the grandmother's house rather than for public interiors
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 去乡下看望祖母时，[X]需要应对不平整户外小路和日常步行，也会准备一双适合在家中穿的干净易穿鞋，同时把行李控制在公交或火车换乘可承受的范围内。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before beginning university in Oulu, [X] prepares one winter footwear system for a snowy housing-to-campus commute, indoor classes, errands, and ordinary city movement, making severe-weather reliability part of a repeated daily routine.
examples: using Daily for housing, shopping, and the recurring campus commute
keeping classrooms and errands within the student's Daily routine rather than inferring a profession
using Outdoor for the explicitly discussed snow and severe cold between destinations
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 即将到奥卢读大学时，[X]会为积雪中的住处到校园通勤、室内课程、日常采购及城市活动规划一套冬季鞋履系统，使严寒可靠性成为反复出现的日常需求。

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a homebody mother's six-person birthday dinner at home, [X]'s family orders upscale pickup and hires a server so the mother can dress for the meal, host between kitchen and table, and still keep the slippers-and-comfort atmosphere she prefers.
examples: using Home/Indoor for the explicitly chosen home venue and hosting flow
using Party for the birthday meal and guest-facing period
preserving the polished-top-and-slippers tension without inflating the intimate dinner into a Formal Event
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 偏爱宅家且喜欢美食的母亲选择在家举办六人生日晚餐时，[X]一家会购买较精致的外带餐并请服务人员，让母亲既能打扮后在厨房和餐桌间招待客人，也能保留自己喜欢的拖鞋与舒适氛围。

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A management candidate preparing for an interview in a business-formal workplace narrows footwear to polished black or brown dress shoes that coordinate with the selected suit and belt while remaining comfortable through arrival, waiting, the interview, and a possible office walk-through.
examples: using Office/Business for the interview and workplace setting
using Formal Event for the stated business-formal standard
treating the role as a candidate's real professional context without assuming an offer
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名应聘管理岗位的人为采用商务正装规范的面试准备鞋履，将范围缩小到能与已选西装和腰带协调的黑色或棕色抛光正装鞋，并考虑到达、等候、面试及可能参观办公室时的舒适性。
